capacityLightHint: Capacity Management is in Light mode. Switch to Full in settings to enable the calculation tab.
errCalendarGlobalNoProjects: No planner projects available for global update
calendarPickPerson: Select a person on the left to edit absences
calendarYearFallback: No production calendar for: {years} — weekend fallback used.
shareHandoffHint: Share the link after saving the sprint
noAccessToProject: No access to project {key}, or the planner is not connected to it. Pick an available project above.
sprintNotFoundFallback: Sprint from the link was not found; opened the latest one
ganttRoleSwitchDirtyText: The selected role has unsaved Gantt changes. Switch without saving?
planningRolesNoSprint: Pick a sprint in the widget header or create a new one to plan role load.
planningRolesNoActive: Open the plugin settings and pick at least one functional role.
planningPeopleNoSprint: Pick a sprint in the widget header or create a new one.
planningPeopleEmptyTitleTpl: No assignees picked for role «{role}» yet
planningPeopleEmptyDesc: Click the button below to load the current list of assignees from the Assignee field bundle.
roleSwitchDirtyText: Role «{role}» has unsaved changes. They will be lost if you switch. Continue?
descModelSimple: No personal calculation: role-level resource allocation only.
descModelLight: Personal per-assignee resource; total is summed automatically.
descCapacityMode: Light — current planning behaviour, unchanged. Full — per-sprint personal capacity from the production calendar, grades and absences, shown on a dedicated calculation tab.
hintDtaWarnings: When enabled, the workflow emits per-role plan-vs-fact progress messages on each work-item logging: under 90% — informational ratio, 90-100% — warning that less than 10% of the plan remains, over 100% — overrun alert. The role label and advice text are localised. Disable this checkbox if you only need the silent fact-field aggregation.
hintDta: When enabled, the bundled workflow rule aggregates issue work items by type and writes the result into per-role fact-fields according to the mapping below. Each work item type may be mapped to a single role only.
dtaErrDuplicate: A work item type cannot be mapped to two different roles. Remove the duplicate row before saving.
errDuplicateEstField: The same estimate field cannot be selected for two different roles. Each role must point to its own period field.
errDuplicateFactField: The same fact field cannot be selected for two different roles. Each role must point to its own period field.
hintSsbInline: Direct editing of issue fields in the planner table (dynEditEnabled).
hintSsbDta: Differentiated time accounting workflow active — work items are aggregated into per-role fact-fields.
hintSsbCascade: Cascade aggregation parent ← child active — child plan/fact fields roll up into level-2/level-3 parents.
dtaEmptyTable: No mappings yet. Click «+ Add mapping» to add one.
cardCascade: Cascade aggregation of estimates and work hours
hintCascade: When enabled, the bundled workflow rule sums per-role plan/fact fields (derived from DTA Fields → Estimate/Fact mapping) from child issues into their level-2/level-3 parents along the configured parent link. Hierarchy max 2 levels (task → level-2 → level-3).
lblForbidContainer: Forbid direct work-item logging on container issues
hintForbidContainer: When enabled, saves are rejected if a user tries to add or edit work items on issues whose kind matches a level-2 or level-3 container value. Time logging must happen on leaf child issues only.
warnCascadeWithoutForbid: Cascade is on while forbid is off: any direct work-item logged on a container issue will be overwritten by the next cascade aggregation. Enable «Forbid direct logging» to keep aggregated values consistent.
hintCascadeLevel3Optional: Leave empty if you only need 1-step aggregation (task → level-2). When set, cascade extends to level-3 (level-2 → level-3).
warnCascadeLevelsOverlap: Level-2 and level-3 must not share a value — overlap is ambiguous and breaks aggregation.
hintCascadeManualEstTag: A parent issue carrying this tag is excluded from cascade aggregation — its estimate/spent-time fields are never overwritten by the children sum. Leave empty to disable.
hintOtherFieldsRequired: If not selected, the project field named “Priority” / “State” is used by default; saving is not blocked, a warning is shown.
hintValGroup: Required for approval: only members of these groups can validate and finish a sprint. Without a group, validation is unavailable to everyone.
hintEditGroup: Required: only members of these groups can save sprint composition and parameters. Without a group, writing is closed for everyone (YouTrack instance admin is the exception).
hintHistClearGroup: Only members of this group can completely clear the entire sprint history of the project.
hintAssignerGroup: Members can change task assignees and start/end dates without full edit rights. Hierarchy: editor⊃assigner⊃viewer.
sprintLockNoRights: Insufficient rights: the toggle is managed by the group from the “Access control” settings
toastSprintCreationLocked: Creating new sprints is blocked by the administrator
toastSprintViewOnlyRole: Sprint “{sprint}” is view-only: role “{role}” is in status “{status}”. To change it, use “Edit” in the sprint history.
hintSprintLockGroup: Members can flip the sprint-creation lock toggle in the planner header. Existing sprints keep working while the lock is on.
hintPlanningManagerGroup: Members of this group can edit planning settings (roles, fields, norms, modes), but not workflow rules or access rights — those stay with the settings manager.
toastNoHistClearRights: Insufficient rights to clear sprint history
overlimitModalBody: Current allocation exceeds the available resource. To fix it, reduce allocations or raise the resource. If you leave it as is — the sprint status will be downgraded to Draft and require re-validation.
overlimitModalBodyTpl: Current allocation for role "{role}" exceeds the available resource. To fix it, reduce allocations or raise the resource. If you leave it as is — the sprint status will be downgraded to Draft and require re-validation.
toastOverlimitDowngraded: Sprint status downgraded due to overlimit. Fix and re-validate.
toastAllocatedLockHint: Sprint is distributed — table is read-only. To edit, open the sprint from history with "Open for edit".
lblDynEdit: Direct editing of YouTrack issue fields from sprint table
tooltipDynEdit: When enabled, the sprint table gains extra columns (Fact, Resource, Allocation) and the State/System/Priority/XPriority cells become editable with direct write-back to YouTrack issues. Be mindful of YouTrack API load on bulk edits.
descDynEdit: When enabled: the sprint composition table fields become interactive; changes are applied to YouTrack issues with confirmation.
bannerCfg: One or more previously selected fields have been removed or changed type. Please fix the configuration.
bannerNoSettings: Plugin settings are not filled in. Open the settings widget via the “Plugin settings” button in the header (available to members of the settings management group).
ganttReassignNoRights: You don't have rights to reassign tasks.
ganttReassignDisabledByInlineEdit: Enable inline editing of YouTrack fields in settings to reassign tasks on the Gantt chart.
hintShowDiagLogUi: Shows the «Diagnostic log» block at the bottom of the widget. Hidden by default; enable only when investigating an incident.
errRevConflict: The sprint was modified by another user. Reload the page and try saving again.
errSlotRevConflict: The data was modified by another user. Reload the page and try saving again.
toastEditsBlockedRevConflict: Editing is frozen: your data is out of sync with the server. Reload the page.
hintWcIndicator: A working copy exists — click to open editing
wcCloseBody: You have an in-progress edit for the current sprint/role. Changes are auto-saved — you can resume later from History.
wcSpoilerNotice: This is an in-progress edit by {who}, {when}
titleSaveCurrentRoleParams: Force-save the per-person distribution and update the sprint history record
emptyAssignees: Select a sprint and click “Pick Assignees”
emptyGantt: Select a sprint and assign tasks to team members
btnExportHistoryTitle: Download all sprint history as JSON
btnImportHistoryTitle: Load sprint history from a JSON file
importHistCrossFork: ℹ File from another plugin fork ({fork}). Import is allowed.
importHistCrossInstance: File from a different YouTrack instance. Task links point to the source instance.
importHistVersionWarn: Plugin version in file ({v}) is newer than installed. Data loss is possible.
btnImportReplaceTitle: Clears all history and replaces with file content (requires historyManager role)
importReplaceWarn: This will erase all current history and replace it with the file contents.
toastHistImportInvalid: File is not a sprint history export
draftSavedAtTitle: Local draft in browser. Use “Clear draft” to reload the server version.
btnClearDraftTitle: Delete local draft and load server version
clearDraftConfirmBody: All unsaved changes will be lost. The server version stays intact.
toastDraftStale: Server data was updated by another user — draft is not applied
toastDraftTooLarge: Draft is too large for local storage
clearAllHistWarn: This action will permanently delete all history records.
clearAllHistInfo: Data is stored in YouTrack and cannot be restored. Continue?
confirmClearTask: Remove all tasks from the current sprint (role)?
confirmClearAssignees: Clear the entire assignee list? Task assignments will be preserved.
confirmDelHist: Delete history record? It will be restored on next validation.
confirmFinishSprint: Mark sprint as “Closed”? This action is irreversible.
confirmFinishAllRoles: Mark all unfinished roles of this sprint as “Closed”? The outcome and retro note will be written to every role. This action is irreversible.
toastSaveParamsForeignSprint: A different sprint is selected — parameters can only be saved for the working sprint
titlePickAll: Select all results across all pages
toastPickAllLimit: Loaded {n} tasks. Limit reached — refine the query to select more.
toastPickPageMetaLost: Metadata for some tasks is lost — repeat the search
toastXlsxErr: XLSX library not loaded. Check your network connection.
toastAssigneesEmpty: Assignee list is empty. Click “Pick Assignees” first.
toastSelectRoleFirst: Select sprint role before picking assignees.
toastNoUserField: No user field set for role “{role}” — go to Settings → User Fields by Role.
toastPickEmpty: Field bundle contains no users. Check field settings in YouTrack.
toastDateError: End date cannot be before start date
overlimitTooltip: Allocation of one or more tasks exceeds the task resource (delta)
toastRefreshNotActive: Refresh is available only for the active sprint.
toastRefreshBusyEditing: Finish editing the cell before refreshing.
refreshConflictBody: The update will affect {n} tasks. {k} of them contain your unsaved changes.
toastSyncFromYtNoField: Assignee field is not configured for the role.
excelDiffHighlightLegend: Column “Δ” marks rows that differ between sheets (assignee, dates, estimate, allocation, inclusion).
compSprintEmpty: Sprint composition is empty. Click "+ Pick Tasks".
compEmptyDesc: Pick tasks from YouTrack to build the sprint composition for this role.
tooltipNoRightsEdit: Insufficient rights. Sprint editing group required.
tooltipNoRightsVal: Insufficient rights. Sprint validation group required.
btnOpenSettingsTitle: Open plugin settings (available to members of the settings management group)
bannerNotConfigured: Plugin not configured. Project admin must set the management group in Project Settings → Apps → Sprint Planner.
btnCloseSettingsTitle: Close settings and return to planning
settingsNotConfiguredHint: Project admin must set the settings management group in Project Settings → Apps → Sprint Planner. Until then, the plugin is in read-only mode.
settingsNoAccessHint: Contact your project admin. Plugin settings management is restricted to a dedicated group.
overlimitWarnSrv: Server: resource overlimit detected for role {role}
wcLevel_ALLOCATED_REVAL: Allocations changed — re-validation up to «Distributed» required
wcLevel_CONFIRMED_REVAL: Composition or estimates changed — re-validation up to «Composition agreed» required
wcDiffNoChanges: No diff — working copy is identical to the snapshot.
wcDiscardConfirmBody: All unsaved changes in the working copy will be lost. The base history record is not affected.
wcDiscardedToast: Working copy discarded. The base snapshot was not modified.
wcConflictBody: The base snapshot was modified ({who}) after this working copy was opened.
wcMultiTabBody: This working copy is being edited in another tab. Continue here? Changes from the other tab may be overwritten.
wcStorageQuotaExceeded: Working-copies storage quota reached. Discard old unfinished edits.
hintStateRollup: When enabled, the bundled workflow rule recomputes container State (Story / Epic) as the least-progressed state across child issues whenever any child State changes. Reuses the hierarchy config from «Cascade aggregation» above. Disable if you have custom state-propagation workflows.
hintStateRollupNoHierarchy: Rollup needs hierarchy config from «Cascade aggregation» above (kind field + level-2 / level-3 values). Fill that section first.
hintStateRollupOrder: Select states from the project bundle and order them from «least progressed» (Open / Backlog) at the top to «most progressed» (Done / Closed) at the bottom. The rollup picks the topmost state across all children. Minimum 2 states.
warnStateRollupOrderShort: State order must contain at least 2 states.
lblStateRollupResolved: Resolved states (won’t be reopened by rollup)
hintStateRollupResolved: When a container is already in any of these states, rollup will not change it back. Typically: Done, Cancelled. Leave empty to disable the guard (containers will follow children even after closing).
hintStateRollupFloor: Containers won’t drop below this state even if children would push them lower. Use to keep Epics out of «Backlog» once analysis has started.
lblAllowOverlimit: Allow planning with role resource over-allocation
descAllowOverlimit: When enabled: validation is not blocked and the over-limit dialog is not shown when a role's total allocation exceeds its resource. Negative remainders are still shown in red as an indicator.
hintSsbOverlimit: Planning with role resource over-allocation is allowed (validation not blocked, over-limit dialog suppressed)
phSprintGoal: What the team wants to achieve by sprint end
hintSprintGoal: One or two lines. Not a task list — an outcome.
toastSprintGoalMissing: Sprint goal is empty — consider adding one
hintNewSprintRoles: Select the roles that will take part in this sprint. The set cannot be changed after creation.
phGoalRetroNote: What worked / didn't work toward this goal
hintStandupStateRoles: In a single-role view, only sections of that role's states are shown; the role's tasks in other states go to the «Other states» section. Leave empty to show every state.
standupStateRolesEmpty: No mapping — add a state → role row
hintStandupHiddenStates: Sections for these states (and their tasks) are not shown in the Stand-up view.
hintStandupDoneStates: Used by reporting (spillover and resolution time). The Stand-up view groups tasks by every state of the bundle.
hintBacklogZonesGate: The “Backlog” section appears in the navigation once at least one zone is added.
backlogZonesEmpty: No zones — add a state → role mapping
backlogErrDupState: A state is mapped more than once — remove duplicates.
backlogAssignNoSprint: Select or create a sprint first
backlogUnmappedWarn: task(s) in unmapped states — check the zone mapping
backlogInSprintHint: This task is already part of a sprint — do not add it again
standupNoSprint: Pick a sprint in the widget header or create a new one.
standupEmptyRole: Add tasks to the role composition to build the stand-up.
standupGoalMissing: Sprint goal is not set. Add it in the Sprint Intro card.
globalNoProjects: No available projects with the planner enabled. Attach the app to a project (Project Settings → Apps), select the settings manager group in the app settings (a required field), then open the planner in the project settings.
globalPickPrompt: Select a project in the header to start planning.
bannerProjectLoadFailed: Project data failed to load ({reason}). The screen may be incomplete — reload the page or pick the project again.
globalSwitchDiscardMsg: The current project has unsaved and unvalidated changes. Switching projects will clear the local draft. Continue?
projectMovedToMenu: Sprint planning has moved to YouTrack's main menu. This screen is the planner settings for the project.

_meta.name: English
_meta.source: Original (extracted from legacy-monolith.js I18N.en in v1.1.0)

relSetEnable: Enable release management for the project
relSetMappingAnchorNote: The state mapped to “Planned” also anchors the traffic light: issues still in it count as not started (red zone).
relSetTagMappingNote: Tag mapping: entering a status removes the previous status tag and adds the new one. Pick existing tags — an auto-created tag would be private to its owner.
relEmptyHint: Create the first release to collect project tasks into it
relHintFreezeRule: Optional · rule “freeze ≤ plan” applies when both dates are set
relHintManagerDefault: Prefilled with the creating release manager, editable
relValFreezeAfterPlan: Freeze date cannot be later than the plan date
relPickerNoGroups: Set up candidate groups in release management settings
relPickerLoadError: Couldn’t load candidates — check rights / group membership
relArchivedToast: Older closed releases moved to archive: {n}
relTransferPrompt: These tasks already belong to other active releases. Transfer them to “{name}”?
relTransferFrozenNote: Cannot transfer from frozen releases — unfreeze their scope first:
relTransferTargetLocked: Release scope is frozen or closed — cannot add tasks
relFreezeConfirm: «{name}»: adding and removing tasks will be locked. Fields, dates and notes stay editable. Continue?
relUnfreezeConfirm: «{name}»: the scope can be changed again. Unfreeze?
relFreezeHintRelease: Recommendation: freeze no later than 3 business days before the planned date.
relFreezeHintHotfix: Hotfix: relaxed freeze (1 business day / as needed), can be skipped.
relConfirmClose: «{name}»: the scope will be captured as a snapshot and the release will move to history. This is irreversible. Continue?
relDeleteConfirm: Delete release “{name}”? This cannot be undone.
relPvMappingLine: Mapping: status “{status}” → state “{state}”. Check the tasks to apply it to.
relPvDesync: out of sync — moved outside the planner
relRbLine: Rollback via the state field history: each task returns to its value before the last transition (date shown next to the current state). Uncheck tasks you don't want to roll back.
relRbSmConflict: {n} task(s) not rolled back — the reverse transition is likely forbidden (State Machine conflict). See the error panel for details.
relRmIssueConfirm: {id}: the issue will be removed from the “{name}” release composition; the release status tag will be removed. Proceed?
relRmIssueDone: Issue removed from the release composition
relPvNoMapping: No state mapping configured for status “{status}”
repSetEnable: Enable reporting module for the project
repSetThHint: Working days in a status before a flag is raised. Empty = status not monitored. Red must exceed yellow.
repSetThEmpty: Load State field values first (set the State field in sprint parameters).
repSetA1Hint: Mark statuses whose entry counts as movement; the label is the caption shown in the report.
repSetA2AnchorsHint: Milestone = first entry into a state. A metric is computed only when both ends are set.
repSetA2NormsHint: A median above the norm is flagged by the traffic light. Cycle has no norm.
repSetA2TpHint: How the "closed" milestone is read when an issue is reopened: first close stops the metric at the first entry into the end anchor; settled close — at the last one. Cycle sums development episodes accordingly.
repSetA2PausesHint: A pause = an interval in a pause status or under a pause tag; it is subtracted from TTM. Unmarked time accrues into TTM.
repSetA8FlowHint: Ordered work-flow statuses. Bottleneck = median dwell + WIP per status; rework = moves backwards against this order. Empty order = status is outside the flow.
repIdleHint: Report not built yet. Choose parameters and click “Build report”.
repParamsDirty: Parameters changed — showing the previous result. Click “Build report” to recalculate.
repEmpty: No active tasks match the filter
repIncomplete: Data incomplete: history truncated by the limit, metric hidden. Issues affected: {n}.
repLimitHit: Only the first {n} matching tasks were processed — data may be incomplete; narrow the filter.
repA1Sub: what got done in the period
repA1NoTargets: No target statuses configured — set them in Reporting settings
repA1PopNote: Counts issues that are in a target status when the report is built; issues reopened afterwards or moved further along are not included.
repRangePrompt: Select both dates of the range
repA2Sub: Median delivery time for the period
repRiskSuffix: items: analysis started long ago, still not in business testing
repA2NoAnchors: TTM anchors not set — configure the metrics in Reporting settings
repA2NoPauses: Pause markers not set — TTM without subtracting pauses
repFlowNoFlow: Flow statuses are not configured (set at least 2 statuses in settings).
repFlowEmpty: No flow data for the selection.
repA4Sub: logged hours by person and role
repA4Empty: No logged hours for the period
repA5Empty: No tasks over threshold for the period
repSetA5Hint: Tasks whose |variance| exceeds the threshold are listed; the estimate is taken as-of entry into the lead start.
repA3NoDoneCfg: No target statuses configured — all tasks are counted as WIP; set them in Reporting settings
repSetA3Hint: Names of YT fields for the A3 business columns; a column is shown only when its field is set.
repA6NoBacklogHint: Backlog states are not configured — counting all unresolved issues
repA4Menu: Effort: hours by people and roles
repA5Menu: Plan vs fact: estimate accuracy by role
repA6Menu: Backlog in hours: months of work by role
repSetA6Hint: Monthly capacity per role (hours/month) — the denominator of «months of backlog».
repSetA10AgeHint: Consecutive not-done sprints before the tail-age badge turns yellow / red.
repA11Sub: Role velocity from closed-sprint snapshots: closed hours per sprint and plan completion %, rolling average over a window.
repA11WindowNote: Rolling window: the last {n} closed sprints of each role.
repA11Empty: No closed sprints with role data — nothing to compute velocity from.
repA11NoDoneCfg: Done-states are not configured (Stand-up done-states or State Rollup order) — closed hours count as zero.
repSetA11Hint: Velocity rolling-average window: how many of the role's most recent closed sprints are averaged.
repA10SectUnder: Underfulfilment by role (not-done hrs / committed hrs)
repA10SectAge: Tail age · zombie issues (consecutive not-done sprints)
repA10NoN1: No next snapshot — all tails shown as dropped
repA10NoDoneCfg: Reporting done-states not set — using standup fallback
repB3Sub: Flow of small tagged tasks in the period vs the monthly pace year-to-date
repB3NoTag: The "thousand small tasks" tag is not set in settings
repSetB3TagHint: YouTrack tag marking small tasks. B3 counts tasks with this tag created in the selected period, plus the monthly pace year-to-date.
repB1Sub: Tech-debt volume by role (Σ estimates in person-hours) and share of all types, split by system
repB1Menu: Technical debt: volume and share by role
repB1NoCfg: Tech-debt filter is not set — specify an issue type or a tag in settings
repB2Sub: Share of engineering hours spent on bugs rather than features, broken down by system and role
repB2Menu: Bug tax: hours on bugs vs features
repB2NoCfg: Bug type or bug→feature link types are not set — specify them in settings
repB0Menu: Roll-up: monthly metric trend by system
repB0Sub: Monthly trend of key metrics by system over recent months
repB0NoCfg: Lead anchor pair is not set (required for TTM and plan-fact) — configure it in reporting settings
repB0Empty: No data for the selected period
repB0NoFlowHint: Flow states are not set — the Bottleneck chart stays empty
repB0NoBacklogHint: Backlog states are not set — backlog charts stay empty
repSetB1Hint: Tech-debt filter: issue type OR tag (one of two; if a type is set, the tag is ignored). Empty → the B1 report shows a hint.
repSetB2Hint: A bug is an issue of this type. A "feature" is an issue linked to a bug by one of the given link types. The metric is the share of hours on bugs out of total hours (bugs + features). Empty → report B2 shows a hint.
repSetTimeoutHint: Maximum report data-collection time; on expiry the report auto-cancels and rolls back (prevents hangs).
repSetMaxIssuesHint: Ceiling for tasks loaded into snapshot reports (WIP/Done, Backlog hrs, Tech debt, Summary): pages of 200 up to the cap. Raising it slows report builds.
repSetShowSystem: Show the System field in reports
repSetShowSystemHint: Adds a System column to report tables and groups management reports by system; when off, it is hidden in the UI and in XLSX/PDF exports.
forecastConfirmText: Dates will be recalculated and overwritten for all assigned tasks of the role, including manually adjusted ones. Continue?
toastForecastEmpty: No assigned tasks with estimates — nothing to forecast
toastForecastNoDates: Sprint has no dates — cannot forecast
descAutoForecast: Enables the “Forecast dates” button and the task queue controls on the assignee distribution level.
descCrossRoleExclude: Excluding an issue from the sprint in one role (by status change or by the trash button) also excludes it in the other roles of that sprint. Un-excluding does not cascade — do it per role.
allocSummaryLegend: Red — issues of roles over the capacity limit. The role column header shows allocation / resource.
descAllocSummary: Read-only summary above the role accordions: all sprint issues deduplicated, an estimate per active role and a row total. Issues of over-limit roles are highlighted in red.
hintRelCandMgr: Not a permission but a pool: the release manager is picked from these groups in the release card.
hintRelCandEng: Not a permission but a pool: the release engineer is picked from these groups in the release card.
hintRelMgr: Full rights in release management: create, edit, change status and delete releases.
hintRelEng: Release engineer rights: build and change release status, without full management.
hintRepA: Tier A — operational reports for team leads.
hintRepB: Tier B — management reports. Tier B members also see all tier A reports (B ⊇ A).
permTableLead: A tick grants the group a permission. Hover a column header to read what it allows.
permDeleteRow: Remove the group from the table
permDeleteTitle: Remove the group from the settings?
permDeleteConfirm: The group “{group}” will be removed from the table and all {n} permission(s) granted to it will be revoked. The change takes effect once the settings are saved.
permManagerNote: The settings manager holds every permission. Its group is set in the app settings: Project → Apps.
permOrphanHint: The group was not found in YouTrack — it may have been deleted or renamed. The permissions granted to it are kept.
permAllUsersHint: YouTrack does not pass this group to the app — permissions granted through it will not work. Use a group with explicit membership.
permRequiredMark: Required permission: an empty column means nobody may do it
permWarnEmptyVal: With no group in the “Validation” column, nobody but a YouTrack administrator will be able to validate sprints.
permWarnEmptyEdit: With no group in the “Editing” column, nobody but a YouTrack administrator will be able to save sprints.
permTableEmpty: No groups added yet — nobody has been granted any permissions.
hintLinkRoles: Add the links the app should understand and mark what they mean. You pick the wording as seen from the child issue — the reverse one is filled in for you.
hintLinkColHier: Parent → child. These links build the backlog tree and the release scope.
hintLinkColDep: “One before the other.” Shown on the Gantt chart.
hintLinkColInfo: Display only: a marker with the number of related issues. Does not affect calculations.
linkTypeGone: type not found in the tracker
linkTypesEmpty: Link types could not be loaded. Settings will be saved unchanged.
linkEmptyDefaults: Nothing added — the default set applies: subtasks as hierarchy, «Depend» as a dependency, «Relates» as a reference link.
hintLinkFirstHier: Estimate cascade and parent state rollup use only the FIRST link marked «Hierarchy» — it carries a star.
linkModOff: this module is currently off in the project
hintCascadeUsesLinks: Which link counts as the parent one is set in «Issue links»: the first link marked «Hierarchy» is used.
ganttExtDeps: Waiting on issues outside the sprint
hintDisplayFields: Add the project fields you want to see as columns in the issue tables, and mark which tables they belong in.
hintDfColSummary: A column in the «Shared resource allocation» summary table.
hintDfColRole: A column in the role scope table.
hintDfColMy: A column in the issue table of the «My role» tab.
dfFieldGone: field not found in the project
dfFieldsEmpty: Project fields could not be loaded. Settings will be saved unchanged.
hintDfNotStored: Field values are never stored by the app: they are read from YouTrack when the table opens, so everyone sees exactly what they are allowed to.
dfLoadFailed: Values loaded only partly. Use «Refresh from issue» to try again.
ganttLinksPartial: Links loaded only partly. Use «Refresh from issue» to try again.
plannerDisableConfirmBody: The project will disappear from the planner project picker for regular users, and main-menu service will stop. Planner data is kept; a project settings manager or an administrator can re-enable it. Automatic workflow rules (cascade aggregation, state rollup) will keep running in the project.
plannerDisabledBanner: The planner is disabled in this project. Data is kept; a project settings manager or an administrator can re-enable it.
errPlannerDisabled: The planner is disabled in this project — changes were not saved. Your draft is intact; contact the project settings manager.
bannerRegisterFailed: Failed to register the widget in YouTrack. Reload the page (F5). If the error persists, contact your administrator.
hintZombieValue: The value is saved but missing from the current bundle
ganttVmError: Failed to build the Gantt chart
repA11Easter: The answer to the ultimate question of life, the universe, and planning.
